      g)     Grant Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the U.S. Department of
             Transportation, Federal Transit Administration for a Section 5339(b) Competitive,
             and Section 5339 Formula Grant for the Cheyenne Transit Facility Renovation at
             1800 Westland Rd. (FTA Section 5339 Grant)

Mr. Moody moved to approve in an amount of $4,143,600.00, seconded by Mr. White. Motion
carried by unanimous voice vote.

Erin Johnson, Transit Administrator, provided a staff report. Committee members Moody and
Wolfe commented on the item. Public comment was made by Charles Miller.

      h)     Grant Agreement between the City of Cheyenne and the U.S. Department of
             Transportation, Federal Transit Administration for a Section 5307   — Operating
             Assistance, ADA Paratransit Operating assistance, PM Vehicles/Facilities, &
             Capital Grant for the Cheyenne Transit System Program. (FTA Section 5307 Grant)

Mr. Wolfe moved to approve in an amount of $3,291,390.00, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion
carried by unanimous voice vote.

Erin Johnson, Transit Administrator, provided a staff report and committee member Moody
commented on the item.

32.   CONTRACT MODIFICATIONS:

      b)     Contract Modification #2 to Contract #795 5 between the City of Cheyenne and
             Trihydro Corporation for Landfill Mapping and Surveying Services. (Solid Waste
             Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $49,008.00, seconded by Mr. Wolfe.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Samuele Quattrini, Landfill Manager, provided a staff report. Committee members Moody and
Wolfe commented on the item. Public comment was made by Charles Miller.

      c)     Contract Modification #1 to Contract #8259 between the City of Cheyenne and
             SPARE Labs Inc. for Transit Paratransit Dispatch System and new Fixed Route
             Tracking System. (Transit Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $78,000.00, seconded by Mr. White.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Erin Johnson, Transit Administrator, provided a staff report and committee member Moody
commented on the item. Public comment was made by Charles Miller.
